knowledge_gaps: The diagnostic gate is undefined: specify cohort size, age bins, isolation threshold, random-control repetitions, effect threshold, and uncertainty. Greater sensitivity to isolated events does not establish that their influence harms accuracy.

Deletion changes both history content and positional embeddings. Position-preserving masking and compacted deletion need separate controls, with explicit final-target alignment and exclusion of future interactions.

The consistency loss lacks candidate count and sampling distribution, temperature, weight grid, reduction, dropout handling, and scheduling. A detached clean prediction can preserve existing errors; stability alone does not demonstrate improvement.

Compare targeted deletion consistency with random-deletion consistency and a simple recency baseline under equal search budgets. Otherwise, improvements cannot be attributed to semantic targeting. Define TF–IDF settings, missing-text handling, and duplicate-item treatment.

The report needs a concrete GPU-time allocation, checkpoint-selection rule, and stopping policy. Repeated validation selection can overfit 200 users per category; paired intervals do not account for search bias. Explicitly retain full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for the twenty training users.

Originality 5/10 and difficulty 4/10 remain provisional without comparison to existing sequential-recommendation augmentation and consistency methods. Potential 7/10 is speculative because no diagnostic effect or accuracy gain has been measured, and the supplied references have not been independently verified.
